text:
[RCLI.1.2] **What each subcommand does.** The grammar states which invocations
parse; this states what they produce.

- `compile` compiles one module, resolving its imports against the `-L` search
  path ([LIMP.3.1]), to one `.dsc` at the path `-o` names ([RCLI.2.1]).
- `compile-project` compiles every module under a sketch directory's `rules/`,
  each to its own `.dsc` ([RCLI.1.4]).
- `dump-schemas` emits proto3 source for the schemas the input declares
  ([RCLI.1.5]), or with `--json` a JSON document describing them, their units
  included ([RCLI.1.14]). It produces no `.dsc`.
- `dump-ast` writes the input's syntax tree ([RCLI.1.10]). It produces no `.dsc`.
- `check` gives `compile`'s verdict ([RCLI.1.12]). It produces no `.dsc`.
